title: Sink
description: spec of the Sink manifest: the address base, the class ceiling, the retention period and, for exports, export_only (E2).

base.description: Address base; the address is built from the base, the tenant and the delivery id (DLV-6).

ceiling.description: Ceiling of the class of what is written.

retention.description: Retention period of what is written.

recipient.description: The only recipient in the old form: the principal or admin. From v0.2 recipient_ref is used; exactly one of the two is set (lint export_only_recipient).

recipient_ref.description: From v0.2: the only recipient: admin or the person as human:<id> (SEC-10).

config.description: Driver configuration; it is closed by the driver schema.
